name: Arizona Commerce Authority TSMC Registered Technician Apprenticeship Expansion
known_limitations: The announcement identifies program partners, occupations, planned investment, and a 2025 recruitment target. It does not report completions, retention, placement outcomes, total regional labor demand, construction-trade capacity, or proof that the workforce pipeline is sufficient for all planned fabs and suppliers.
automation_notes: Track cohort enrollment, completion, credential attainment, retention, placement, later apprenticeship expansions, and independent workforce-demand data.
notes: Phase 51B named workforce record. The November 19, 2024 release says TSMC Arizona planned to recruit and hire nearly 130 apprentices and trainees in 2025 across facilities, equipment, process, and manufacturing technician pathways.
